question.text: On the day of pay-in, whose responsibility is it to ensure sufficient funds are available in the clearing bank account?

explanation.text: The Logic: It is the function of the clearing member to ensure funds are available in the clearing bank account on the day of pay-in. The Trap: The clearing bank and the clearing corporation facilitate the process, but the source assigns the funding obligation to the clearing member. Note: Pay-in funding is a fundamental responsibility of the clearing member in the cash-segment settlement flow.
